BFA.note: States nothing on an authentication service.
ANCI is a coordination body for identification initiatives; no record link or shared responsibility for both registers is stated.
Family code bill only recognises customary and religious marriages in the civil register; no digital register is stated.

systems.system: Autorité nationale de coordination de l'identification (ANCI)

BFA.note: No enrolment count or share is stated.
No number at birth is stated.
No statement on who operates or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on an ID number is stated.
A decree creates ANCI to accompany a strategic plan for the unique identifier; a plan and a coordinating body, no system built or piloted.
Nothing on local civil registration offices.
